assertions.name: Downloaded source passes its actual Node regression command
The native application starts with the required empty state
Blank titles are rejected with an accessible error
Enter submits a trimmed task title
The Add task button creates a second task
Completed filter retains only the checked task
Active filter retains only the unfinished task
Deleting a task removes only that task
Reload preserves completion and deletion in actual localStorage
The UI enforces the 80-character title boundary
Keyboard navigation gives the next control visible focus
Generated application fits a 390px viewport without horizontal overflow
Corrupt storage recovers to an empty list with a clear message
Generated application raises no JavaScript errors or external requests
